first_superspace_jet.role: exact geometry-level first superspace-jet prolongation into convention-separated linearized W
source_references: arXiv:2007.05097 Section 2, Eqs. (2.19)-(2.23), the 11D review inside the 10D Weyl-covariance paper

first_superspace_jet.j_one_109_over_1056_assessment: not an expected physical response of a complete pure local-Lorentz orbit: torsion transforms homogeneously under Lorentz and its zero-background trace should remain zero. It is a real obstruction to treating the tested p=2 column as a complete Lorentz gauge representative, but not an obstruction to 11D supergravity. It is not certified Lorentz-gauge-removable. Only a separately completed super-Weyl orbit could test scale-gauge removal.
first_superspace_jet.howe_scale_removability_scope: Howe proves local removal only for a closed Weyl connection in the standard on-shell dimension-zero-torsion complex, with the stated topological qualification. That result does not authorize subtracting the p=2 local-Lorentz residual in an off-shell X/J-deformed complex.
first_superspace_jet.cederwall_scope: The pure-spinor BRST cohomology is an on-shell spectrum and equation-of-motion oracle. It does not print the missing off-shell H_hat-to-jet map or a compensating J term.
first_superspace_jet.boundary: The source-fixed algebraic geometry maps now have an exact first spinor-jet prolongation through D omega, D J^(1), D J^(2), D J^(+), mixed torsion, and both published linearized W conventions. The missing step is the compensator-eliminated H_hat jet that supplies D C_{alpha beta}{}^gamma, D C_{alpha,b}{}^c, and C_{alpha,a}{}^gamma consistently, including ordered-superderivative momentum terms. Until that map is source-fixed, W(H_hat), complete F, F A G_p, Bianchi closure, and off-shell closure remain false.
